8e17c7c fixed a bug. mCurPage should be set to null immediately when last page is popped, even if there is an transition animation to play
a138660 added support for page restore/recovery.
66126f4 refactored PageManager and Page to make the API calls more consistent.
f2dbecb refacoted PageManager to better support per-Page transition animations. added ViewWrapper.onMenuPressed() to handle press on the menu button
3c476c4 added a few more lifecycle methods, which may not be that useful in real life, they exist to make the framework complete :)
9927741 minor change to improve ZoomPageAnimator
04e9849 updated the docs
c1150c9 * reformat the entire project to use 2-space tab. * deprecate use of ViewWrapper.mContext, use getContext() instead. * some minor optimization and improvements.
c18799e added log messages for PageManager
85b9501 allow Page to customize transition animation.
51de900 rename
d7157ab refactored PageAnimationManager, passing Page instead of View as argument to methods of PageAnimationManager
c9f255d reverted 06d16b7b,  because the mAnimating flag may cause other problems, sometimes it will silently ignore some "popPage" operations, which in some cases is not expected.
05f23d3 fixed a bug that PageManager.popToClasses() did not work as expected.
f046940 renamed methods in PageManager and added PageManager.popToClasses(), and removed unnecessary methods.
a3ad79b argument rename
bfdfe7c added PageManager.lastIndexOfPage()
e1d2035 added PageManager.popPagesTillSpecifiedClass()
6287ba5 popPagesTillSpecifiedPage() needs not to take the "mAnimating" state into account, because this method is normally invoked programmatically.
b27a5ee added ViewWrapper.onAttach() & ViewWrapper.onDetach(), which are called when the view is added or removed from the view hierarchy.
42bc670 renamed the packages
650d538 ensures PageActivity read annotations from all subclasses in the inheritance hierarchy.
6cab13e fixed a bug in PageManager.popPagesTillSpecifiedPage(), which may pop all innocent pages expcept for the first one.
bcb02da seperated the project into a library & demo project.
9b93cce adjusted the order of method calling in PageManager.pushPage & PageManager.popPage
19c83ba fixed a bug that view of the removed page is not properly removed from the view container
964ad94 refactored Paginize, the refactor fixed a series of bugs.
06d16b7 improved PageManager
dde36f1 initial import

This structure was introduced in f2dbecb, which moved these four statements (previously executed immediately, before the animation delay check) all into the delayed callback.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: f2dbecb84ec45427f76bf02fc29fa1a8b2c9dd2e

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `PageManager.java` via `git log --follow`, then inspected each commit's diff to `popPageInternal`/pop-related logic, working backward from the fix commit `8e17c7c`. The fix undoes a very specific structural change: it splits `mContainerView.removeView(...)` and `mCurPage = prevPage` out of `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` and executes them immediately (before the animation-delay branch), while leaving `onDetach()`/`onHidden()` in the deferred method.

**(2) The bug-introducing change:** Commit `f2dbecb` ("refacoted PageManager to better support per-Page transition animations") refactored `popPageInternal` by extracting the post-pop cleanup into a new `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` method, and — critically — moved `mContainerView.removeView(removedPage.getView())`, `removedPage.onDetach()`, and `mCurPage = prevPage` from their prior *unconditional, immediate* location into this new method. Since `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` is only invoked immediately when there's no animation, but is scheduled via `postDelayed(..., animationDuration)` when an animation is playing, `mCurPage` (and the view removal) got deferred until the animation finished. Before this refactor, `mCurPage = prevPage` and the view removal always executed synchronously regardless of animation state — only `onHidden()`/`onUncovered()` were deferred.

**(3) Evidence:** Diffing `f2dbecb` shows the exact statements (`removeView`, `onDetach`, `mCurPage = prevPage`) moving from immediate execution into the newly-created `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`. All subsequent commits (`3c476c4`, `66126f4`, `a138660`) preserve this structure unchanged in the relevant lines, confirming the bug persisted from `f2dbecb` all the way to the fix commit `8e17c7c`, which restores `mCurPage = prevPage` (and the view removal) to immediate/unconditional execution — exactly reversing what `f2dbecb` did.

I'm confident in this attribution since the fix is a near-exact structural reversal of `f2dbecb`'s change, and no other commit in the history touches these specific lines.
